column1: # P976 — the GNU family counter-measurement. P960's mechanism was an ORDERED first-match test:
# a GPL-2.0 preamble references the LGPL inside the read window, so testing "gnu lesser" before
# "gnu general public" returns LGPL for a GPL payload. These are raw case-insensitive COUNTS from
# payloads read this pass. A ratio separates the two families where an ordered match does not.
# Recorded as a MEASUREMENT. No classifier was written or changed (P237, P970).
